name: Trevose Golf & Country Club
stayType: Golf resort with lodges, bungalows and apartments
accommodation: Fairway Lodges and Fairway Cottage (sleep 6), Trevose Lodges (sleep 4), three-bedroom bungalows (sleep 5), Trehuel and Dormy apartments (sleep 2-4) and a Club Flat (sleep 6)
suitableFor: Couples, families and groups who want self-catering with leisure facilities
beachAccess: The clubhouse overlooks the coast towards Booby's Bay and Constantine Bay
confirmedFeatures: Three golf courses, driving range, padel, tennis, gym, restaurant and bar
overview: A golf and country club close to Constantine Bay, a short drive from Harlyn Bay, with self-catering lodges, bungalows and apartments sleeping from two to six. Alongside three golf courses, guests have padel, tennis, a gym and an on-site restaurant and bar. Many of the apartments have sea views and gardens.
surfTripFit: Constantine, Booby's and Harlyn are all close, so you can choose the beach that suits the swell each day.
